records.introduction: ZuiGO's service pages list representative technology stacks, chosen per project rather than fixed. Custom Software: React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS. AI & Machine Learning: Python, PyTorch, Claude / OpenAI APIs, LangChain, Vector DBs, FastAPI, MLflow, AWS / GCP. Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Grafana / Prometheus. Healthcare: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FHIR / HL7, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker. Fintech: TypeScript, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe / payment APIs, Kafka, AWS.
records.provenance: Compiled from the technology lists on the five zuigo.ai service-page snapshots; not a separate page on the website.
